Website data

This site provides game information and support resources. The site code includes no analytics or advertising trackers, user accounts, or form collection system. Language switching uses separate page URLs and does not set a preference cookie.

Hosting and external links

The hosting provider may process technical logs, such as IP addresses and request information, to deliver and secure the site. External stores and services apply their own privacy terms when you open their links.

Support correspondence

If you request support by email, the information you provide is processed through an email service provider to handle your request. Correspondence and deletion requests are retained for up to 12 months after closure and then deleted, except for records that must be kept by law. Contact support to request earlier deletion. Do not send unnecessary personal information, passwords, or payment card details.
